# Cold War Project: decolonization scripted buttons (generated by gen_buttons.py in the decolonization thread's scratchpad; edit freely)
# Cooldowns are variables on the pressing country (<button>_cd); the engine has no cooldown field for buttons.

### The Winds of Change: superpowers

cwp_woc_champion_self_determination_button = {
	name = "cwp_woc_champion_self_determination_button"
	desc = "cwp_woc_champion_self_determination_button_desc"

	visible = {
		OR = {
			c:USA ?= this
			c:RUS ?= this
		}
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_woc_not_champion_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = cwp_champions_self_determination }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_button_cooldown_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = cwp_woc_champion_self_determination_button_cd }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		set_variable = {
			name = cwp_woc_champion_self_determination_button_cd
			months = 60
		}
		set_variable = cwp_champions_self_determination
		remove_variable = cwp_guards_allied_empires
		remove_modifier = cwp_guardian_of_allied_empires
		add_modifier = { name = cwp_champion_of_self_determination }
		every_country = {
			limit = { cwp_is_tracked_colony = yes }
			change_relations = { country = root value = 10 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = cwp_colonial_power
				NOT = { this = root }
			}
			change_relations = { country = root value = -10 }
		}
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { c:USA ?= this }
			add = 10
			if = { limit = { cwp_has_anticolonial_leaning_government = yes } add = 10 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { c:RUS ?= this }
			add = 100
		}
	}
}

cwp_woc_guard_allied_empires_button = {
	name = "cwp_woc_guard_allied_empires_button"
	desc = "cwp_woc_guard_allied_empires_button_desc"

	visible = {
		OR = {
			c:USA ?= this
			c:RUS ?= this
		}
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_woc_not_champion_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = cwp_guards_allied_empires }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_button_cooldown_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = cwp_woc_guard_allied_empires_button_cd }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		set_variable = {
			name = cwp_woc_guard_allied_empires_button_cd
			months = 60
		}
		set_variable = cwp_guards_allied_empires
		remove_variable = cwp_champions_self_determination
		remove_modifier = cwp_champion_of_self_determination
		add_modifier = { name = cwp_guardian_of_allied_empires }
		every_country = {
			limit = { cwp_is_tracked_colony = yes }
			change_relations = { country = root value = -10 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = cwp_colonial_power
				NOT = { this = root }
			}
			change_relations = { country = root value = 10 }
		}
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { c:USA ?= this }
			add = 5
			if = { limit = { cwp_has_imperialist_leaning_government = yes } add = 10 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { c:RUS ?= this }
			add = 0
		}
	}
}

### The Winds of Change: metropoles

cwp_woc_development_funds_button = {
	name = "cwp_woc_development_funds_button"
	desc = "cwp_woc_development_funds_button_desc"

	visible = {
		has_variable = cwp_colonial_power
		cwp_has_tracked_colonies = yes
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_has_tracked_colonies_tt
			cwp_has_tracked_colonies = yes
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_button_cooldown_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = cwp_woc_development_funds_button_cd }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		set_variable = {
			name = cwp_woc_development_funds_button_cd
			months = 60
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = cwp_colonial_development_funds
			years = 5
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_medium
		}
		every_direct_subject = {
			limit = { cwp_is_tracked_colony = yes }
			add_modifier = {
				name = cwp_colonial_development_funds_subject
				years = 5
			}
		}
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 5
		if = { limit = { cwp_has_anticolonial_leaning_government = yes } add = 10 }
		if = { limit = { scaled_debt > 0.5 } multiply = 0.2 }
	}
}

cwp_woc_promise_self_government_button = {
	name = "cwp_woc_promise_self_government_button"
	desc = "cwp_woc_promise_self_government_button_desc"

	visible = {
		has_variable = cwp_colonial_power
		cwp_has_tracked_colonies = yes
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_has_tracked_colonies_tt
			cwp_has_tracked_colonies = yes
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_button_cooldown_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = cwp_woc_promise_self_government_button_cd }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		set_variable = {
			name = cwp_woc_promise_self_government_button_cd
			months = 36
		}
		every_direct_subject = {
			limit = { cwp_is_tracked_colony = yes }
			add_liberty_desire = -10
			add_modifier = {
				name = cwp_self_government_promised
				years = 3
			}
		}
		scope:journal_entry ?= {
			add_progress = {
				name = cwp_tide_bar
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 5
		if = { limit = { cwp_has_anticolonial_leaning_government = yes } add = 5 }
	}
}

cwp_woc_hold_the_line_button = {
	name = "cwp_woc_hold_the_line_button"
	desc = "cwp_woc_hold_the_line_button_desc"

	visible = {
		has_variable = cwp_colonial_power
		cwp_has_tracked_colonies = yes
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_has_tracked_colonies_tt
			cwp_has_tracked_colonies = yes
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_button_cooldown_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = cwp_woc_hold_the_line_button_cd }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		set_variable = {
			name = cwp_woc_hold_the_line_button_cd
			months = 36
		}
		every_direct_subject = {
			limit = { cwp_is_tracked_colony = yes }
			add_modifier = {
				name = cwp_colonial_repression
				years = 3
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = cwp_colonial_repression_metropole
			years = 3
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_medium
		}
		change_infamy = 5
		scope:journal_entry ?= {
			add_progress = {
				name = cwp_tide_bar
				value = 1
			}
		}
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 3
		if = { limit = { cwp_has_imperialist_leaning_government = yes } add = 10 }
		if = { limit = { cwp_has_anticolonial_leaning_government = yes } multiply = 0.2 }
	}
}

cwp_woc_managed_withdrawal_button = {
	name = "cwp_woc_managed_withdrawal_button"
	desc = "cwp_woc_managed_withdrawal_button_desc"

	visible = {
		has_variable = cwp_colonial_power
		cwp_has_tracked_colonies = yes
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_woc_managed_withdrawal_button_possible_tt
			any_direct_subject = {
				cwp_is_tracked_colony = yes
				OR = {
					liberty_desire >= 75
					has_variable = cwp_independence_promised
				}
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_button_cooldown_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = cwp_woc_managed_withdrawal_button_cd }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		set_variable = {
			name = cwp_woc_managed_withdrawal_button_cd
			months = 12
		}
		ordered_direct_subject = {
			limit = {
				cwp_is_tracked_colony = yes
				OR = {
					liberty_desire >= 75
					has_variable = cwp_independence_promised
				}
			}
			order_by = liberty_desire
			max = 1
			cwp_decolonization_negotiated_independence = { METROPOLE = root }
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = cwp_end_of_empire
			years = 5
			is_decaying = yes
		}
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = { limit = { cwp_has_anticolonial_leaning_government = yes } add = 10 }
		if = { limit = { scaled_debt > 0.5 } add = 10 }
		if = { limit = { cwp_has_imperialist_leaning_government = yes } multiply = 0.25 }
		if = { limit = { any_direct_subject = { has_variable = cwp_independence_promised } } add = 50 }
	}
}

### The Winds of Change: colonies

cwp_woc_nationalist_campaign_button = {
	name = "cwp_woc_nationalist_campaign_button"
	desc = "cwp_woc_nationalist_campaign_button_desc"

	visible = {
		cwp_is_tracked_colony = yes
	}

	possible = {
		is_subject = yes
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_button_cooldown_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = cwp_woc_nationalist_campaign_button_cd }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		set_variable = {
			name = cwp_woc_nationalist_campaign_button_cd
			months = 24
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = cwp_nationalist_campaign
			years = 2
		}
		overlord = {
			change_relations = {
				country = root
				value = -10
			}
		}
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 10
	}
}

### India: the Transfer of Power

cwp_india_cabinet_mission_button = {
	name = "cwp_india_cabinet_mission_button"
	desc = "cwp_india_cabinet_mission_button_desc"

	visible = {
		c:GBR ?= this
	}

	possible = {
		always = yes
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_button_cooldown_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = cwp_india_cabinet_mission_button_cd }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		set_variable = {
			name = cwp_india_cabinet_mission_button_cd
			months = 24
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = cwp_india_cabinet_mission
			months = 12
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = cwp_india_cabinet_mission
			months = 12
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_small
		}
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 15
	}
}

cwp_india_restore_order_button = {
	name = "cwp_india_restore_order_button"
	desc = "cwp_india_restore_order_button_desc"

	visible = {

	}

	possible = {
		always = yes
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_button_cooldown_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = cwp_india_restore_order_button_cd }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		set_variable = {
			name = cwp_india_restore_order_button_cd
			months = 24
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = cwp_india_restore_order
			months = 12
		}
		change_infamy = 3
		c:HND ?= {
			add_liberty_desire = -10
			change_relations = {
				country = root
				value = -15
			}
		}
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 2
		if = { limit = { cwp_has_imperialist_leaning_government = yes } add = 6 }
		if = { limit = { cwp_has_anticolonial_leaning_government = yes } multiply = 0.25 }
	}
}

cwp_india_set_date_button = {
	name = "cwp_india_set_date_button"
	desc = "cwp_india_set_date_button_desc"

	visible = {
		c:GBR ?= this
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_india_no_date_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = cwp_india_withdrawal_announced }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_india_set_date_button_possible_tt
			OR = {
				c:HND ?= { liberty_desire >= 60 }
				AND = {
					cwp_has_anticolonial_leaning_government = yes
					has_global_variable = cwp_tide_tier
					global_var:cwp_tide_tier >= 1
				}
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		set_variable = cwp_india_withdrawal_announced
		custom_tooltip = cwp_india_set_date_button_effect_tt
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 5
		if = { limit = { cwp_has_anticolonial_leaning_government = yes } add = 20 }
		if = { limit = { scaled_debt > 0.5 } add = 10 }
		if = { limit = { c:HND ?= { liberty_desire >= 75 } } add = 20 }
		if = { limit = { cwp_has_imperialist_leaning_government = yes } multiply = 0.25 }
	}
}

### Indonesia: the National Revolution

cwp_indonesia_police_action_button = {
	name = "cwp_indonesia_police_action_button"
	desc = "cwp_indonesia_police_action_button_desc"

	visible = {
		c:NET ?= this
	}

	possible = {
		c:IDS ?= { has_war_with = root }
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_button_cooldown_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = cwp_indonesia_police_action_button_cd }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		set_variable = {
			name = cwp_indonesia_police_action_button_cd
			months = 18
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = cwp_indonesia_police_action
			months = 6
		}
		set_variable = cwp_indonesia_police_action_taken
		add_modifier = {
			name = cwp_indonesia_police_action
			months = 6
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_medium
		}
		change_infamy = 5
		c:USA ?= {
			change_relations = {
				country = root
				value = -15
			}
		}
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 10
		if = { limit = { cwp_has_imperialist_leaning_government = yes } add = 10 }
	}
}

cwp_indonesia_talks_button = {
	name = "cwp_indonesia_talks_button"
	desc = "cwp_indonesia_talks_button_desc"

	visible = {
		c:NET ?= this
	}

	possible = {
		always = yes
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_button_cooldown_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = cwp_indonesia_talks_button_cd }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		set_variable = {
			name = cwp_indonesia_talks_button_cd
			months = 24
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = cwp_indonesia_talks
			months = 24
		}
		c:NET ?= {
			every_scope_war = {
				limit = { any_war_participant = { c:IDS ?= this } }
				add_war_war_support = {
					target = c:NET
					value = -3
				}
			}
		}
		c:NET ?= {
			every_scope_war = {
				limit = { any_war_participant = { c:IDS ?= this } }
				add_war_war_support = {
					target = c:IDS
					value = -3
				}
			}
		}
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 5
		if = { limit = { cwp_has_anticolonial_leaning_government = yes } add = 10 }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = cwp_indonesia_us_pressure_applied } add = 10 }
	}
}

cwp_indonesia_round_table_button = {
	name = "cwp_indonesia_round_table_button"
	desc = "cwp_indonesia_round_table_button_desc"

	visible = {
		c:NET ?= this
	}

	possible = {
		cwp_indonesia_round_table_ready = yes
	}

	effect = {
		cwp_indonesia_end_war = yes
		cwp_indonesia_transfer_sovereignty = yes
		c:IDS ?= {
			change_relations = {
				country = root
				value = 30
			}
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = cwp_end_of_empire
			years = 5
			is_decaying = yes
		}
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 10
		if = { limit = { cwp_has_anticolonial_leaning_government = yes } add = 15 }
		if = { limit = { scaled_debt > 0.5 } add = 10 }
		if = { limit = { cwp_has_imperialist_leaning_government = yes } multiply = 0.25 }
	}
}

cwp_indonesia_marshall_pressure_button = {
	name = "cwp_indonesia_marshall_pressure_button"
	desc = "cwp_indonesia_marshall_pressure_button_desc"

	visible = {
		c:USA ?= this
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_indonesia_marshall_pressure_button_possible_tt
			OR = {
				c:NET ?= { has_variable = cwp_indonesia_police_action_taken }
				c:IDS ?= { has_variable = cwp_indonesia_diplomacy }
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_button_cooldown_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = cwp_indonesia_marshall_pressure_button_cd }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		set_variable = {
			name = cwp_indonesia_marshall_pressure_button_cd
			months = 24
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = cwp_indonesia_marshall_pressure
			months = 12
		}
		set_global_variable = cwp_indonesia_us_pressure_applied
		c:NET ?= {
			add_modifier = {
				name = cwp_indonesia_marshall_aid_suspended
				months = 12
				multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_medium
			}
			change_relations = {
				country = root
				value = -20
			}
		}
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 10
		if = { limit = { has_variable = cwp_champions_self_determination } add = 15 }
	}
}

### Indochina: the war

cwp_indochina_reinforce_button = {
	name = "cwp_indochina_reinforce_button"
	desc = "cwp_indochina_reinforce_button_desc"

	visible = {
		c:FRA ?= this
	}

	possible = {
		c:DAI ?= { has_war_with = root }
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_button_cooldown_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = cwp_indochina_reinforce_button_cd }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		set_variable = {
			name = cwp_indochina_reinforce_button_cd
			months = 12
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = cwp_indochina_reinforcements
			months = 12
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = cwp_indochina_expeditionary_corps
			months = 12
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_medium
		}
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 15
		if = { limit = { cwp_has_imperialist_leaning_government = yes } add = 10 }
		if = { limit = { cwp_has_anticolonial_leaning_government = yes } multiply = 0.5 }
	}
}

cwp_indochina_french_offensive_button = {
	name = "cwp_indochina_french_offensive_button"
	desc = "cwp_indochina_french_offensive_button_desc"

	visible = {
		c:FRA ?= this
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_indochina_peoples_war_phase_tt
			has_global_variable = cwp_indochina_peoples_war_phase
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_indochina_french_offensive_button_possible_tt
			any_scope_war = {
				any_war_participant = { c:DAI ?= this }
				has_war_support = {
					target = c:DAI
					value < 50
				}
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		cwp_indochina_end_peoples_war = { ATTACKER = root }
		c:DAI ?= { trigger_event = { id = cwp_indochina.2 popup = yes } }
		trigger_event = { id = cwp_indochina.2 popup = yes }
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 15
	}
}

cwp_indochina_general_offensive_button = {
	name = "cwp_indochina_general_offensive_button"
	desc = "cwp_indochina_general_offensive_button_desc"

	visible = {
		c:DAI ?= this
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_indochina_peoples_war_phase_tt
			has_global_variable = cwp_indochina_peoples_war_phase
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_indochina_general_offensive_button_possible_tt
			OR = {
				any_scope_war = {
					any_war_participant = { c:FRA ?= this }
					has_war_support = {
						target = c:FRA
						value < 50
					}
				}
				has_state_in_state_region = STATE_ANNAM
				has_state_in_state_region = STATE_MEKONG
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		cwp_indochina_end_peoples_war = { ATTACKER = root }
		c:FRA ?= { trigger_event = { id = cwp_indochina.2 popup = yes } }
		trigger_event = { id = cwp_indochina.2 popup = yes }
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 15
	}
}

}

cwp_indochina_negotiate_button = {
	name = "cwp_indochina_negotiate_button"
	desc = "cwp_indochina_negotiate_button_desc"

	visible = {
		c:FRA ?= this
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_indochina_no_negotiations_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = cwp_indochina_negotiations }
		}
		c:DAI ?= { has_war_with = root }
		cwp_indochina_war_turned = yes
	}

	effect = {
		set_variable = cwp_indochina_negotiations
		custom_tooltip = cwp_indochina_negotiate_button_effect_tt
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 5
		if = { limit = { cwp_has_anticolonial_leaning_government = yes } add = 15 }
		if = { limit = { scaled_debt > 0.5 } add = 10 }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = cwp_indochina_months global_var:cwp_indochina_months >= 60 } add = 15 }
		if = { limit = { c:USA ?= { has_variable = cwp_indochina_american_aid } } multiply = 0.5 }
	}
}

### Algeria

cwp_algeria_pacification_button = {
	name = "cwp_algeria_pacification_button"
	desc = "cwp_algeria_pacification_button_desc"

	visible = {
		c:FRA ?= this
	}

	possible = {
		always = yes
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_button_cooldown_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = cwp_algeria_pacification_button_cd }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		set_variable = {
			name = cwp_algeria_pacification_button_cd
			months = 12
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = cwp_algeria_pacification
			months = 12
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = cwp_algeria_pacification
			months = 12
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_medium
		}
		change_infamy = 3
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 15
		if = { limit = { cwp_has_imperialist_leaning_government = yes } add = 10 }
	}
}

			months = 24
		}

			months = 24

cwp_algeria_referendum_button = {
	name = "cwp_algeria_referendum_button"
	desc = "cwp_algeria_referendum_button_desc"

	visible = {
		c:FRA ?= this
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_algeria_no_offer_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = cwp_algeria_self_determination }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_algeria_referendum_button_possible_tt
			scope:journal_entry ?= { "scripted_bar_progress(cwp_algeria_insurgency_bar)" >= 40 }
			OR = {
				has_variable = cwp_algeria_strongman
				cwp_has_anticolonial_leaning_government = yes
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		set_variable = cwp_algeria_self_determination
		custom_tooltip = cwp_algeria_referendum_button_effect_tt
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 5
		if = { limit = { has_variable = cwp_algeria_strongman } add = 20 }
		if = { limit = { cwp_has_anticolonial_leaning_government = yes } add = 10 }
		if = { limit = { scope:journal_entry ?= { "scripted_bar_progress(cwp_algeria_insurgency_bar)" >= 70 } } add = 20 }
	}
}
